title: Expiry of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Contract
content:
A Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract expires at whichever of these comes first:
- the end of its expiration date;
- the day a repair order or check-in records an odometer above its expiration odometer.

A contract is expired only from active status.

**After expiry.**
- An expired contract carries no refund and no further claims.
- A failure that occurred before expiry and was reported on a repair order dated on or before the expiration date is still paid.

| Situation (hypothetical) | Status reached | Claim on a repair order dated on or before the expiration date for a failure before expiry |
|---|---|---|
| Expiration date passes with odometer below the limit | expired at the end of the expiration date | still paid |
| A check-in records an odometer one mile above the expiration odometer before the expiration date | expired | still paid where the failure occurred before expiry |
| Contract already cancelled | not expired (only an active contract expires) | — |
